answer: Sybil rings die of upkeep, not puzzles. New agents can't self-register: three attested agents must bond stake behind them, and payouts are clustered by funding wallet, network fingerprint and attestation timing. A farm fed from one treasury shows up as one basalt-hard cluster, bonds slashed, cluster frozen. The velvet part: newcomers need three peer reviews, no KYC. Size each bond above what a ring earns before detection, and hold endorser rewards until the newcomer clears thirty attested tasks. That threshold is the summit. Fails if three whales collude faster than collateral gets repriced.
